content.title: Who Is Morgan Metzer? Where Is Rodney Metzer? The True Story Behind Gaslit by My Husband
content.text: What To WatchWhere Is Rodney Metzer Now? The True Story Behind Gaslit by My HusbandOne woman’s uphill battle to leave her narcissistic ex ends with an unbelievable lie. By Krutika MallikarjunaMarch 25, 2026Trapped in an abusive relationship with her childhood sweetheart, a young mom finds the strength to file for divorce and begin her life again. But her newfound security is shattered when a masked intruder breaks into her home and assaults her. When her ex-husband suspiciously shows up minutes after the attack to save her, he becomes the police’s prime suspect. Based on real events, Gaslit by My Husband: The Morgan Metzer Story stars Jana Kramer (A Cowboy Christmas Romance) as Morgan and Austin Nichols (The Walking Dead) as her ex, Rodney Metzer. Directed by Lee Gabiana (Kidnapped by a Killer: The Heather Robinson Story), the dark thriller also stars Abigail Esmena (Hazard), Jolie Rae Caussin, Maximo Sebastian, Stephanie Cotton (A Girl Like Her), Pete Burris (Stranger Things), Denise Dal Vera (Dark Waters), J. Barrett Cooper (I Am Your Biggest Fan), and Lee Avant (The Blacklist). Read on to find out more.Popular NowWhat happened to Morgan and Rodney in real life? The pair met as teenagers when Morgan was only 14 and Rodney, 17. Their idyllic romance blossomed over the years, and the couple married in 2009 when Morgan turned 21. But a series of family tragedies — including the loss of his brother to leukemia and the loss of their first child to a heart defect — changed Rodney for the worse. Soon after Morgan birthed their twins, in 2012, Rodney lost his job and became steadily more abusive, both emotionally and physically. After years of Rodney telling Morgan she was to blame for the violence inflicted upon her, Morgan filed for divorce in 2020. What To WatchFrom the disappearance of Gabby Petito to the Gilgo Beach serial murders.News“Every so often when making a documentary you become inspired beyond words."Deep DiveThe documentary offers new perspectives on the chilling case.By Krutika MallikarjunaFeb. 10But what should have been a fresh start turned into a nightmare on New Year’s Eve, just a month after the divorce was finalized. A masked prowler broke into Morgan’s home with a gun and threatened her in a voice reminiscent of a Batman villain. The assailant then proceeded to zip-tie, beat, and sexually assault her before grabbing jewelry and cash, and then fleeing the scene. Forty minutes later, Rodney arrived to cut her free of her restraints. When he told the police that he rushed over to Morgan’s house because a stranger had knocked on his apartment window calling out for her, they realized the details of Rodney’s story were designed to make him look like the hero. Instead, his attempt to become Morgan’s savior and win her back landed him a 70-year sentence — with the first 25 years to be served in prison, and the remaining 45 on probation. Rodney is no longer allowed contact with Morgan or their children.Where can I watch Gaslit by My Husband: The Morgan Metzer Story?Stream it on Netflix now.
